notes.title: "Walpurgisnacht" update (Build 04.30.22)
notes.notes:
Greetings, witches! As you don your costumes and light those bonfires, check out the new kinds of chicanery the ScreamCap team is getting themselves in. As the night approaches and we prepare to transition out of Early Access and launch the Full Release, be wary, Believers. Something wicked this way comes…

[list]
[*] Game complete, woot! This version debuts the full game with all its content.
[*] New fancy visual effects to make the stream a bit more snazzy. 
[*] New animations for the things that dwell beyond our veil of understanding. 
[*] New music, ambiance and sound effects for every chapter. 
[*] 4 full character routes to aid in your investigation.
[*] All story endings - try to find them all!
[*] Fixes and alterations we made for our beloved users based on your great feedback! Thank you!
[/list]

notes.title: "Valentine's Day of the Dead" update (Build 02.14.22)
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine's Day! We convened with the hell hounds of love, and brought you the official Raz Romance Route!

[list]
[*] Brand new (and some consider dateable) character: Raz
[*] Now, you're able to delve into the unknown with this nervous wreck by your side, and maybe uncover some deeper truths about the thing tailing our crew of misfits
[*] When you're not fawning over your newest little meow meow, keep an eye out for some new viewers in chat, and the disembodied voices of your other teammates offering tips on your investigation
[*] Love isn't easy, it's terrifying!
[*] But remember, chocolate hearts go on sale tomorrow!
[/list]

[*] Updated credits to include two of our early-stage developers - thanks for your help and great ideas Jasper and Isa, and thanks to Jack for your late-stage input
